# googleworkspace_user (Resource)

A Google Workspace user account.

Existing accounts are adopted with an `import` block or `tofu import`, by user ID or primary email. Creating an account requires `password_wo`; importing one does not.

~> Destroying this resource **deletes the account**. Google keeps a deleted user restorable for 20 days. To offboard someone, set `suspended = true` instead, and consider `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The initial password is generated ephemerally and sent write-only, so it never
# lands in state or plan files. The user sets their own at first sign-in.
ephemeral "random_password" "jdoe" {
  length = 24
}

resource "googleworkspace_user" "jdoe" {
  primary_email = "jdoe@example.com"
  given_name    = "Jane"
  family_name   = "Doe"
  org_unit_path = "/Board"

  recovery_email = "jane@example.net"
  recovery_phone = "+15095550100"

  password_wo                   = ephemeral.random_password.jdoe.result
  password_wo_version           = "1"
  change_password_at_next_login = true

  # Destroying a user deletes the account. Offboard with `suspended = true`.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `family_name` (String) The user's last name.
- `given_name` (String) The user's first name.
- `primary_email` (String) The user's primary email address. Changing it renames the account in place; Workspace keeps the old address as an alias.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the account is archived. Requires an Archived User license.
- `change_password_at_next_login` (Boolean) Whether the user must change the password at next sign-in. Sent only together with a password (on create, or when `password_wo_version` changes). It is not read back, because Workspace clears the flag once the user signs in.
- `include_in_global_address_list` (Boolean) Whether the user appears in the domain's global address list. Defaults to `true`.
- `org_unit_path` (String) Full path of the organizational unit the user belongs to. Defaults to `/`.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive) Password for the account. **Write-only**: never stored in state. Required on create; ignored afterwards unless `password_wo_version` changes. Pair it with an ephemeral `random_password` so the value never touches disk.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Arbitrary version marker for `password_wo`. Changing it sends the current `password_wo` to Workspace, which is how a password is rotated.
- `recovery_email` (String) Recovery email address, used for self-service password reset. Omit to clear it.
- `recovery_phone` (String) Recovery phone number in E.164 format, e.g. `+15095550100`. Omit to clear it.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the account is suspended. Suspension is the reversible way to offboard a user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Immutable user ID. Used for import (the primary email also works).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Users are imported by their immutable user ID or their primary email.
terraform import googleworkspace_user.jdoe jdoe@example.com
```
